categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the development, construction, operation, and management of hydropower and new energy projects. Its core business is electricity generation and sales, focusing on hydropower with supplementary wind and photovoltaic power generation. It operates large-scale hydropower stations mainly in the Lancang River basin and is expanding its renewable energy portfolio including wind, solar, and integrated energy storage solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced hydropower technologies including cascade and basin-wide integrated development and dispatch. It emphasizes intelligent construction platforms, digital twin reservoir monitoring, and smart power plant management with 5G integration. It also invests in R&D for high-dam seismic risk assessment, non-contact slope monitoring, and domestic control system upgrades for hydropower equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are regional power grids and electricity distributors, notably Yunnan Electric Power Grid and Sichuan State Grid. The company serves the electricity market in southwestern China and neighboring countries such as Myanmar and Cambodia. It also participates actively in wholesale and retail electricity markets within Yunnan Province.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in southwestern China, primarily Yunnan and Sichuan provinces, with hydropower assets also in Tibet and international projects in Myanmar and Cambodia. The company’s hydropower stations are mainly located along the Lancang River basin, with renewable energy projects distributed within Yunnan Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electricity supply chain, focusing on power generation. It develops, constructs, and operates hydropower and renewable energy plants, supplying electricity to downstream grid operators and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include integrated development of hydropower, wind, solar, and energy storage to build multi-energy complementary bases. The company focuses on digital transformation, smart grid integration, and indigenous technology development. R&D efforts target intelligent construction, digital twins, control system localization, and key hydropower technologies to enhance safety, efficiency, and environmental sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through electricity sales from hydropower and renewable energy projects. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment income from equity holdings, and financial instruments. It participates in market-based electricity trading and sells power directly to grid companies and end customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading large-scale hydropower developer and operator in China, especially dominant in the Lancang River basin and southwestern region. It is positioned as a core enterprise in Yunnan’s green energy sector and a key player in the national 'West-to-East Power Transmission' strategy. Competitors include other major state-owned hydropower and renewable energy companies in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company has total assets of approximately RMB 195.2 billion and annual revenue of about RMB 23.46 billion, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.64 billion, showing steady growth. Installed capacity reached 27.53 million kW, including 25.6 million kW hydropower and 1.93 million kW renewable energy. The company completed a major acquisition of Huaneng Sichuan Energy, expanding its asset base and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its integrated basin-wide hydropower development model, leveraging cascade and multi-energy complementary dispatch advantages to maximize resource utilization and grid stability. It offers reliable, clean, and stable electricity supply with strong regulatory compliance and environmental stewardship. Its advanced digital and intelligent management systems, along with localized technology innovations, differentiate it as a modern, efficient, and sustainable green power enterprise.
